text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that was such a shameful run! I'll
never be
able to convince people of the
power of feng shui
like this...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...That said, feeling sorry for myself will
only
lower my luck even further!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to hold my head high and keep
moving
forward!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right. When you work to improve
your
luck, it can take a while to bear
fruit. It's
important to stay diligent even
when you're not
seeing results!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's the same with training! So, let's keep

practicing for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you're right. It's important to treat
yourself.
That's another method of
increasing your luck!
choice_data_list: でも、まずは頑張ったご褒美が必要だよ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I feel like eating something
yummy
today! Lead the way, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Harmonizing your inner qi is above
all else!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Time to rejuvenate and keep moving
forward! I'll
do my best to achieve
happiness!
